title: A Trip to the Mountains
text:
Last summer, my family went on a trip to the mountains. We took a train from the city, and the journey took three hours. The train was full of tourists with big bags.

In the morning, we walked along a small path to a lake. The water was very cold, but my brother swam anyway. In the evening, we ate dinner in a little village and talked about our favourite moments.

people who travel to visit places for fun
a small place where people live, smaller than a town

paragraph_translations: No verão passado, minha família fez uma viagem para as montanhas. Pegamos um trem da cidade, e a viagem durou três horas. O trem estava cheio de turistas com bolsas grandes.

De manhã, caminhamos por um pequeno caminho até um lago. A água estava muito fria, mas meu irmão nadou mesmo assim. À noite, jantamos em uma pequena aldeia e conversamos sobre nossos momentos favoritos.
